description: Independent scenarios illustrating staged review, legitimate exceptions, and the stop-on-UX-failure rule.

gates.name: Baseline and diagnosis
gates.stop_if: no inspected source or unverified assumptions are presented as facts

gates.name: Experience and composition
gates.stop_if: core product UX remains generic or primary task is missing

gates.name: Layout and spacing
gates.stop_if: independent sections collide or content becomes unreachable

gates.name: Typography palette and icons
gates.stop_if: brand choice is overwritten or critical information loses contrast

gates.name: Radius and component finish
gates.stop_if: component finish breaks behavior or accessibility

gates.name: Compare and verify
gates.stop_if: claimed complete without evidence or unresolved P0 task issues

exceptions.situation: playful illustrations and intentional emoji convey lesson content
exceptions.reason: visual play has a purpose and is not automatically a defect

exceptions.situation: tabs and their associated pane deliberately share a border
user requested a single button error fix with approved layout
homepage only offers KPIs and generic cards with no next practice task
exceptions.reason: color and radius cannot repair missing task architecture

exceptions.situation: unrelated emoji beside every KPI and alert
approved bold gradients express a distinctive creative brand
